hero.chip: Case Note: Dr. You, Considering a Clinic
hero.lede: You’re a good doctor. You’ve thought about owning a clinic.
hero.sub: A free online consultation, from a doctor who runs one.

assess.h2: Three stages. Most doctors stumble on at least one.

stages.title: START
stages.line: From idea to opening day, without the expensive mistakes.
stages.teaser: Most first-time owners get this part wrong, and it is rarely the part they worry about.

stages.title: MANAGE
stages.line: A clinic that runs well even when you’re not in the room.
stages.teaser: The clinics that last are built on something most doctors never think to set up.

stages.title: PROFIT
stages.line: Where the real money is, and how it ends up with you.
stages.teaser: Busy is not the same as profitable. Most doctors find that out late.
